Delete your account

This page explains how OxyGold users can request deletion of their account and associated personal data.

Important: Submitting a request starts a support review. Your account is not deleted immediately. Open orders, payments, legal obligations, and verification may affect processing time.

How to request deletion

  1. Sign in to your OxyGold account.
  2. Open your Account page and select Request account deletion.
  3. Enter the reason for your request and confirm that you understand the effects.
  4. Submit the request and retain the support reference number.
Sign in to submit a request

Data handling

Data deletedAccount profile details, saved addresses, and marketing preferences are deleted after the request is verified and approved.
Data retainedTransaction, payment, tax, accounting, security, and fraud-prevention records may be retained where required by law or legitimate business needs.
Questions about deletion? Contact support@oxygold.ai or call +91 81432 71103.
